description: Export a ready deck to PowerPoint (full-slide images), PDF, or a ZIP of slide images. Waits until the file is built (up to 2 minutes) and returns a download URL. Paid plans only. For editable PowerPoint text boxes, tables, and charts, open the deck on genppt.com and choose Editable PowerPoint in the Export menu.

deckId.description: Deck id from genppt_list_decks, genppt_create_deck, or genppt_create_slideshow.

format.description: pptx = PowerPoint, pdf = PDF, images = ZIP of slide images.

sendEmail.description: Email the download link to the account owner in addition to returning downloadUrl. Defaults to false for MCP calls.

name: genppt_export_deck
title: Export deck
